_how_to_use: When the next song is submitted with a release date, paste its pre-save link (from your distributor, or a free tool like Feature.fm / Linkfire / Hypeddit) into presave_url. The page then shows a big 'Pre-save' button at the top. Leave it empty between releases.
headline: New music is coming
intro: Be the first to hear the next ZWrld song. Follow on Spotify and drop your email, and you'll know the day it lands.
